scope: CPU-only exact match-cause partition of the native M95 full-train capture. No model execution, training, native backward, resource measurement, admission or efficacy claim.

selector_contract.all_native_positive: oracle top-score query inside the full native-positive set
selector_contract.deployed: native argmax query recorded by the capture
selector_contract.target_nearest: oracle top-score query nearest to the target object
selector_contract.target_positive: oracle top-score query with a nearest or member cause bound to the target object
